lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: can you help me confirm something?
What is it?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: When I first joined with you,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I gave you some strawberry candy

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: as a friendly gesture, didn't I?
Yes, you gave me a boatload of them.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: A lot of time has passed since then, so I was wondering

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: if you've finished them yet?
I finished them a long time ago.
I shared them with the other Nikkes.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Wow, you did?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: You must have really liked how they tasted.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I'm glad you enjoyed them, hehe!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Oh, you did?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: But that means you probably didn't get to have many for yourself.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Either way,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I'm glad that others got to appreciate them, hehe.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Anyways, I take it that means

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: you're out of strawberry candies?
That's right.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: This is perfect timing, actually,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: because I have a little surprise for you.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I was thinking of trying my hand at making my own candies.
No kidding.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Until now, all I've ever given out are strawberry candies,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: but I was thinking about making something especially suited to your tastes.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: What kind of flavor would you like?
Can you make grape candy?
You don't have to give me more candy.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Sure, I can do grape-strawberry flavor.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: They're going to be delicious, I just know it!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I guess you're tired of candy...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: How about I make you some strawberry-flavored soybean paste?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Actually, now that I've taken everything you've said into consideration,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I think I'm going to make several different flavors

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: and send you a whole bunch of assorted candies, hehe.
Wait a minute...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I'll let you know when they're done!
Diesel?
After that, I don't hear from Diesel for a long time.
